tools.name: process_text
tools.title: Process Text with AI
tools.description: Submit a text-processing task to Nextcloud's AI framework and return the task ID. Use get_task_result to poll until it completes. Common task types: 'core:text2text' (free prompt), 'core:summarize' (summary), 'core:headline' (headline), 'core:extract_topics' (topics).

customId.description: Optional identifier to tag the task for later retrieval

tools.name: get_task_result
tools.title: Get AI Task Result
tools.description: Get the status and result of a Nextcloud AI task previously created by process_text or generate_image. Status is scheduled, running, successful, failed or cancelled.

taskId.description: The task ID returned by process_text or generate_image

tools.name: generate_image
tools.title: Generate Image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Nextcloud's text-to-image AI provider (e.g. Stable Diffusion via LocalAI). Returns the task ID; use get_task_result to check completion.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

savePath.description: Optional Nextcloud path to save the generated image (e.g. '/Photos/generated.png'). If omitted, only the task ID is returned.

tools.name: list_assistant_skills
tools.title: List Assistant Skills
tools.description: List the user's Nextcloud Assistant skills: reusable instructions the Assistant's agent loads when a task matches their description.

tools.name: get_assistant_skill
tools.title: Get Assistant Skill
tools.description: Read one Assistant skill's full SKILL.md: its frontmatter and instructions.

name.description: Skill name, as list_assistant_skills shows it, e.g. "weekly-report"

tools.name: save_assistant_skill
tools.title: Save Assistant Skill
tools.description: Create an Assistant skill, or replace the one with the same name. The description tells the agent when to use it; the content is the Markdown instructions.

name.description: Skill name, as list_assistant_skills shows it, e.g. "weekly-report"

description.description: When the agent should use this skill, in one or two sentences

tools.name: delete_assistant_skill
tools.title: Delete Assistant Skill
tools.description: Delete one of the user's Assistant skills (its folder goes to the trash bin). Skills an admin shares with everyone cannot be deleted here.

name.description: Skill name, as list_assistant_skills shows it, e.g. "weekly-report"

tools.name: list_assistant_assignments
tools.title: List Assistant Assignments
tools.description: List the user's Nextcloud Assistant assignments: prompts the Assistant runs on a schedule.

tools.name: get_assistant_assignment
tools.title: Get Assistant Assignment
tools.description: Get one Assistant assignment by ID.

tools.name: create_assistant_assignment
tools.title: Create Assistant Assignment
tools.description: Schedule a prompt for the Nextcloud Assistant to run, once or on a recurrence (RRULE). The Assistant runs it as the user and notifies them of the result.

prompt.description: What the Assistant should do on each run

startsAt.description: First run, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. "2026-11-16T08:00:00+01:00"

timezone.description: IANA time zone the recurrence follows, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" (default: the user's zone)

tools.name: update_assistant_assignment
tools.title: Update Assistant Assignment
tools.description: Change an Assistant assignment's prompt, start, recurrence or time zone. Fields left out keep their value.

startsAt.description: First run, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. "2026-11-16T08:00:00+01:00"

timezone.description: IANA time zone the recurrence follows, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" (default: the user's zone)

tools.name: delete_assistant_assignment
tools.title: Delete Assistant Assignment
tools.description: Delete an Assistant assignment, so it no longer runs.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.title: Translate Text
tools.description: Translate text between languages using Nextcloud's configured translation provider. If called without text, returns the available languages. Translation runs as a Nextcloud AI task; if it takes longer than about 30 seconds, the task ID is returned for get_task_result.

text.description: Text to translate. Omit to list available languages.

fromLanguage.description: Source language code (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Omit to detect it.

tools.name: get_user_status
tools.title: Get User Status
tools.description: Get the current user's presence status (online, away, DND, invisible, custom message)

userId.description: User ID to check (defaults to the configured Nextcloud user)

tools.name: set_user_status
tools.title: Set User Status
tools.description: Set the current user's status type (online, away, dnd, invisible, offline)

tools.name: set_user_status_message
tools.title: Set User Status Message
tools.description: Set a custom status message with optional emoji icon and auto-clear time

clearAt.description: Unix timestamp when the message should auto-clear (null = never)

tools.name: clear_user_status_message
tools.title: Clear User Status Message
tools.description: Clear the current user's custom status message

tools.name: list_user_statuses
tools.title: List User Statuses
tools.description: List all users' statuses for team presence visibility

limit.description: Maximum number of statuses to return

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List Notifications
tools.description: List all notifications for the current user

tools.name: get_notification
tools.title: Get Notification
tools.description: Get details of a specific notification by ID

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.title: Mark Notification as Read
tools.description: Mark a notification as read (deletes it)

id.description: The notification ID to mark as read

tools.name: delete_all_notifications
tools.title: Delete All Notifications
tools.description: Delete all notifications for the current user

tools.name: list_activity
tools.title: List Activity
tools.description: List recent entries from the Nextcloud activity feed (file changes, shares, comments, calendar/contact edits, etc.) for the current user.

filter.description: Which feed to read: 'all' (default), 'self' (your own actions), or 'by' (others' actions)

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default 50)

since.description: Return activities after this activity_id (for pagination)

sort.description: Sort order by time: 'desc' (newest first, default) or 'asc'

tools.name: get_object_activity
tools.title: Get Object Activity
tools.description: List the activity history for a single object, e.g. one file. Use object_type 'files' with a file ID to see what happened to that file.

object_type.description: The object type to filter by (default 'files')

object_id.description: The object ID (e.g. the Nextcloud file ID)

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default 50)

tools.name: list_announcements
tools.title: List Announcements
tools.description: List announcements from the Nextcloud Announcement Center (org-wide notices such as maintenance windows, events, or news). Returns newest first.

offset.description: Return announcements before this offset (for pagination, default 0)

tools.name: create_announcement
tools.title: Create Announcement
tools.description: Create a new announcement in the Announcement Center. This is visible to all or selected groups and can trigger notifications/emails — use deliberately. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

plainMessage.description: Plain-text version of the message (defaults to message)

groups.description: Group IDs to target, or ['everyone'] for all users (default)

activities.description: Publish to the activity feed (default true)

scheduleTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) to publish the announcement later

deleteTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) to automatically delete the announcement

tools.name: delete_announcement
tools.title: Delete Announcement
tools.description: Delete an announcement by its ID. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tools.name: get_registration_settings
tools.title: Get Registration Settings
tools.description: Read the Nextcloud Registration app settings (self-service signup configuration), such as allowed email domains, whether admin approval is required, and the default group for new users. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tools.name: update_registration_settings
tools.title: Update Registration Settings
tools.description: Update one or more Nextcloud Registration app settings. Boolean settings use the strings 'yes'/'no'; allowed_domains takes a JSON array string (e.g. '["example.com"]'). Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

key.description: The Registration config key to set

settings.description: One or more key/value pairs to update

tools.name: reset_registration_setting
tools.title: Reset Registration Setting
tools.description: Reset a Nextcloud Registration app setting to its default by deleting the stored value. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

key.description: The Registration config key to reset to its default

tools.name: get_terms_of_service
tools.title: Get Terms of Service
tools.description: Read the Nextcloud Terms of Service admin configuration: all published terms (by country/language), the enforcement settings (tos_for_users, tos_on_public_shares), and the valid country and language codes that can be used when setting terms. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tools.name: set_terms_of_service
tools.title: Set Terms of Service
tools.description: Create or update the terms of service for a given country/language pair. If terms already exist for that pair they are replaced, otherwise new terms are created. Use get_terms_of_service to discover valid country/language codes; an invalid code returns an error (HTTP 417). Requires the configured N…

body.description: The terms text (markdown: headers, formatting, lists, links)

tools.name: delete_terms_of_service
tools.title: Delete Terms of Service
tools.description: Delete a single terms of service entry by its id (see get_terms_of_service). Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tools.name: reset_terms_signatures
tools.title: Reset Terms Signatures
tools.description: Reset ALL users' terms of service signatures org-wide, forcing every user to accept the terms again on next login. This is destructive and cannot be undone. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tools.name: update_terms_settings
tools.title: Update Terms Settings
tools.description: Update the Terms of Service enforcement settings: whether logged-in users must accept the terms (tos_for_users) and whether the terms apply to public shares (tos_on_public_shares). Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tosForUsers.description: Require logged-in users to accept the terms

tosOnPublicShares.description: Apply the terms to public shares

tools.name: list_recommendations
tools.title: List Recommendations
tools.description: List files Nextcloud recommends for the configured user (e.g. recently or frequently accessed, recently shared, or files in active folders), including the reason each file is recommended. Respects the user's recommendations setting.

tools.name: social_home_timeline
tools.title: Read Social Home Timeline
tools.description: Read the home timeline in Nextcloud Social: posts from the accounts this user follows, newest first.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_public_timeline
tools.title: Read Social Public Timeline
tools.description: Read the public timeline in Nextcloud Social — every public post this server knows about. Set local to true for posts from this server only.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

local.description: Only posts from this Nextcloud server (default false)

tools.name: social_hashtag_timeline
tools.title: Read Social Hashtag Timeline
tools.description: Read the public posts carrying a given hashtag in Nextcloud Social.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

local.description: Only posts from this Nextcloud server (default false)

tools.name: social_list_timeline
tools.title: Read Social List Timeline
tools.description: Read the timeline of one of this user’s Social lists. Call it without list_id first to see the available lists and their ids.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

list_id.description: The list to read; omit to list the available lists instead

tools.name: social_list_saved_statuses
tools.title: List Saved Social Statuses
tools.description: List the posts this user has favourited or bookmarked in Nextcloud Social.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

kind.description: Which collection to read: favourites (starred) or bookmarks (saved)

tools.name: social_get_status
tools.title: Get Social Status
tools.description: Read one post in Nextcloud Social by its id, optionally with the thread around it (the posts it replies to and the replies to it).

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

include_context.description: Also fetch the surrounding thread (default false)

tools.name: social_status_history
tools.title: Get Social Status Edit History
tools.description: List the successive versions of a post that has been edited in Nextcloud Social.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_upload_media
tools.title: Attach Nextcloud File to Social Post
tools.description: Stage a file from this user’s Nextcloud storage as a media attachment for Nextcloud Social, and return the media id to pass to social_post_status. The file is copied at upload time, so moving or deleting the original later does not empty the post. Nothing is published until the post is made.

path.description: Path to the file inside the user’s Nextcloud files, e.g. Photos/sunset.jpg

description.description: Alt text describing the media, for accessibility

tools.name: social_post_status
tools.title: Post to the Fediverse
tools.description: Publish a post from this user's Nextcloud Social account. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. Supports replies, media attachments (see social_upload_media), polls, content warnings and visibil…

visibility.description: Who sees it: public (world-readable and listed), unlisted, private (followers only), direct (mentioned accounts only). Omitted, the account’s default post privacy applies; a reply to a direct message is direct whatever this says

in_reply_to_id.description: The id of the status this replies to, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

poll.description: Attach a poll to the post

expires_in.description: Seconds until the poll closes, e.g. 86400 for a day

multiple.description: Allow more than one choice (default false)

spoiler_text.description: Content warning shown in place of the post until the reader expands it

language.description: ISO 639 language code of the post, e.g. en

tools.name: social_delete_status
tools.title: Delete Social Post
tools.description: Delete one of this user’s own posts in Nextcloud Social. A delete is federated to the servers that received the post, but copies already shown or cached elsewhere may remain.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_favourite
tools.title: Favourite Social Post
tools.description: Favourite (star) a post in Nextcloud Social. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. The author's server is told who favourited it.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_unfavourite
tools.title: Unfavourite Social Post
tools.description: Remove this user’s favourite from a post in Nextcloud Social.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_boost
tools.title: Boost Social Post
tools.description: Boost (reblog) a post in Nextcloud Social, republishing it to this user's followers. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. Confirm with the user before boosting.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_unboost
tools.title: Undo Social Boost
tools.description: Undo a boost of a post in Nextcloud Social.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_bookmark
tools.title: Bookmark Social Post
tools.description: Bookmark a post in Nextcloud Social so it can be found again. Bookmarks are private to this user and are not federated.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_unbookmark
tools.title: Remove Social Bookmark
tools.description: Remove a bookmark from a post in Nextcloud Social.

status_id.description: The status id, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_lookup_account
tools.title: Look Up Social Account
tools.description: Look up one fediverse account by handle in Nextcloud Social and return its profile and counts.

acct.description: The handle: user for a local account, user@server for a remote one

tools.name: social_account_statuses
tools.title: Read Social Account Posts
tools.description: Read the posts of one fediverse account in Nextcloud Social, newest first.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_list_account_follows
tools.title: List Social Followers or Following
tools.description: List the followers of a fediverse account, or the accounts it follows.

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

direction.description: followers = who follows this account; following = who this account follows

tools.name: social_follow_account
tools.title: Follow Fediverse Account
tools.description: Follow a fediverse account from this user's Nextcloud Social account. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. The other server is told who followed; a locked account has to approve the request fir…

tools.name: social_unfollow_account
tools.title: Unfollow Fediverse Account
tools.description: Stop following a fediverse account from this user’s Nextcloud Social account.

tools.name: social_list_follow_requests
tools.title: List Social Follow Requests
tools.description: List the accounts waiting for this user to approve their follow request in Nextcloud Social.

tools.name: social_respond_follow_request
tools.title: Approve or Reject Social Follow Request
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending follow request in Nextcloud Social. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. Approving lets that account see this user’s followers-only posts.

account_id.description: The id of the requesting account, from social_list_follow_requests

action.description: authorize to approve, reject to decline

tools.name: social_list_notifications
tools.title: List Social Notifications
tools.description: List this user’s Nextcloud Social notifications — mentions, follows, favourites, boosts and poll results — grouped so that forty favourites of one post read as one line.

limit.description: Notifications to read before grouping (default 20, max 50)

max_id.description: Only notifications older than this notification id (page back), as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_dismiss_notifications
tools.title: Dismiss Social Notifications
tools.description: Dismiss one Nextcloud Social notification, or clear all of them when no id is given. Dismissed notifications cannot be brought back.

notification_id.description: The notification to dismiss (its Notification ID); omit to clear every notification, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

tools.name: social_search
tools.title: Search the Fediverse
tools.description: Search Nextcloud Social for accounts, hashtags or post content. Set resolve to true to fetch a handle or post URL this server has never seen — that contacts the remote server.

q.description: The search query: text, a handle, a hashtag or a post URL

type.description: Restrict the search to one kind of result; omit to search all three

resolve.description: Fetch an unknown handle or URL from its home server (default false)

tools.name: generate_social_share_links
tools.title: Generate Social Share Links
tools.description: Generate social-network share URLs (email, X/Twitter, Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp, Bluesky, Diaspora) for an existing Nextcloud public-link share. Only networks whose socialsharing_<network> app is enabled are returned. Provide either share_id or path.

share_id.description: ID of an existing public-link share

path.description: File/folder path; its public-link share is used (must already exist)

networks.description: Optional filter, e.g. ["twitter","email"]. Defaults to all enabled networks.

inputs.name: calendar

inputs.description: Mail account for the unread counts (see list_mail_accounts); skipped if left out

builtins.title: Inbox triage

inputs.name: mailAccountId
inputs.description: Mail account for the unread counts (see list_mail_accounts); skipped if left out

builtins.title: Weekly review
builtins.description: Look back and ahead: recent activity, open tasks and the next seven days' events.

inputs.name: calendar
inputs.description: Calendar to read events from (its URL name, see list_calendars)

builtins.title: Find a meeting slot
builtins.description: Free/busy of the attendees and the rooms free in a time range.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Short label, also the status message

builtins.title: Back at work
